# sink_faucet — articulation audit and repair

Status: **FAIL / incomplete physical certification**. The repaired rig passes synthetic collision checks; the supplied video does not show actuation for this asset. No ARTCHECK_DONE marker is warranted.

- Replaced tower-yaw control with a horizontal side-cartridge axis and fitted carrier/lever landmarks in three calibrated views.
- Rebuilt button positions, inward axes and recesses; removed filled head collision volume.
- Removed nozzle shear; matched terminal spout tangent and nozzle ring normals, with a 1 mm axial dock seam.
- Made primary JSON/GLB/MJCF/URDF share the six original scalar joint names. Preserved the separate free head, tether and latch runtime in free_head.xml; corrected swivel-relative release/redocking orientation.
- Preserved mechanisms-job friction, damping, stiffness and armature priors; restored its 150-degree swivel bound. Kept the existing 250 mm straight extraction fallback and 450 mm optional free-head tether, explicitly unmeasured.

The ten-position sweeps include every original joint with explicit inter-body contacts, including parent/child pairs. Maximum baseline penetration: 25.0192 mm; repaired penetration: 0.0000 mm. The exported visual triangles were also swept at ten positions per joint; see the report for their separate results. Coupled endpoint states: 64. GLB/OBJ maximum vertex discrepancy: 0.00000745 mm.

Calibrated source frames: f0168, f0082, f0008. Strict maximum assembly edge error across these views: 34.00 px; worst frame p95: 18.03 px. These exceed the requested 10 px maximum. All measurements are at 1280 x 1707 before review resizing. Source masks, per-part traced edges, geometry projections and actual CPU Cycles renders are retained. Silhouette fitting, material/specular boundaries, glass, occlusion and calibration/scale uncertainty remain limitations; this is not a 1 cm metric certification.

No maximum actuation or physical stop can be recovered from these unactuated frames. The open cap is a static state, not an observed motion sequence. No q from the 26-front articulation file or 25-part splat state file maps to these joints. Force, mass, friction and hidden hardware details remain priors.

## Connection audit revision

The source model and simulation-rest instance metadata are part of the [connection audit](../../../connection_audit/notes.md). This is not a blanket physics or photo-fit pass. Native contact measurements, failed release trials, source-photo coverage and accepted/rejected pose proposals are recorded there.

Contact geometry uses the authored MJCF convex pieces; open vessels retain separate floors and wall pieces in the revised assembly. Triangle meshes describe the visible surfaces. Source mass, explicit inertia and friction values are priors, not physical measurements. Any retained web3 hold is a display/release policy, not evidence that the asset is supported. Capture poses are retained separately from corrected simulation-rest poses.

The current spout/head frames are transplanted into the mechanism by name. The lower hidden pedestal is shortened to reconcile the fitted rig with the counter plane. Its lower profile is inferred; the explicit source inertia is retained. Extraction follows the measured dock axis.
